module.purpose: Central email/SMS dispatch facade for Cal.com bookings and account notifications. It composes template classes for every lifecycle event (scheduled, rescheduled, cancelled, declined, reschedule requests, seat changes, payments, recordings, digests, org/team/credit notifications) and fans out sends to hosts, team members, and attendees, honoring per-event-type standard email disable flags.
module.summary: This file is the orchestration layer of the emails package: it imports dozens of email template classes and attendee SMS classes, then exports async functions that instantiate the right templates and send them in parallel via Promise.all. A private sendEmail helper wraps template preparation and sending in a promise with error logging. Formatting of the raw CalendarEvent into a displayable form is done through formatCalEvent before templating. Each lifecycle function checks eventTypeDisableHostEmail / eventTypeDisableAttendeeEmail flags derived from the event type metadata so standard emails can be suppressed per event type, or by explicit hostEmailDisabled/attendeeEmailDisabled arguments. Round-robin-specific variants handle newly assigned members, reassignments, and cancellations with reassigned context. Scheduled/rescheduled/cancelled/request/location-change/awaiting-payment flows pair emails with corresponding attendee SMS classes; seat-based bookings use cloneDeep to avoid mutating shared event objects. Account-level utilities cover password reset, team invites, email verification links/codes, organization creation and verification, workflow emails, feedback, broken integrations, disabled apps, slug replacement, no-show fees, Daily video recordings/transcripts, monthly digest, booking redirects, delegation credential disabled, and credit balance warnings/limits.
module.businessContext: Serves Cal.com's scheduling product: every booking lifecycle change must notify organizers and attendees. Failure means users miss confirmations, cancellations, reschedule requests, payments, or recordings — degrading trust in scheduling communications.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When eventType metadata disables host standard emails, no organizer emails are sent on scheduled bookings.
moduleContractTests.then: no OrganizerScheduledEmail is sent for organizer or team members

moduleContractTests.scenario: When eventType metadata disables attendee standard emails, no attendee emails are sent.
moduleContractTests.then: no AttendeeScheduledEmail is sent for any attendee

moduleContractTests.scenario: A scheduled booking sends one organizer email per team member and one attendee email per attendee.
given: calEvent with team.members = [m1, m2] and attendees = [a1, a2]
moduleContractTests.then: OrganizerScheduledEmail sent for organizer and each team member; AttendeeScheduledEmail sent for each attendee

moduleContractTests.scenario: After scheduled emails resolve, a scheduled SMS is sent to all attendees.
moduleContractTests.then: EventSuccessfullyScheduledSMS.sendSMSToAttendees() awaited after all email promises resolve
moduleContractTests.rationale: pins ordering of email then SMS

moduleContractTests.scenario: Rescheduling a seat emails both organizer and the specific attendee.
moduleContractTests.then: OrganizerRescheduledEmail and AttendeeRescheduledEmail sent and rescheduled SMS sent to the attendee

moduleContractTests.scenario: Cancellation emails derive the title via getEventName per attendee, including duration.
moduleContractTests.then: AttendeeCancelledEmail receives title computed from eventName, attendeeName, host, eventType and eventDuration
moduleContractTests.rationale: pins title derivation inputs for cancellation

moduleContractTests.scenario: Round robin cancelled emails are skipped entirely when host emails are disabled.
moduleContractTests.then: returns early with no emails or SMS sent

moduleContractTests.scenario: Existing attendees who are in the newGuests list receive AttendeeScheduledEmail, others receive AttendeeAddGuestsEmail.
given: calEvent with attendees where one email is in newGuests
moduleContractTests.then: attendee in newGuests gets AttendeeScheduledEmail; remaining attendees get AttendeeAddGuestsEmail; organizer gets OrganizerAddGuestsEmail
moduleContractTests.rationale: pins branch between scheduled vs add-guests email per attendee

moduleContractTests.scenario: Credit balance low warning does nothing when neither team admins nor user provided.
moduleContractTests.then: no email sent, resolves without error

moduleContractTests.scenario: No-show fee charged email is suppressed when attendee standard emails are disabled.
Rescheduled booking sends SMS to all attendees after emails.
moduleContractTests.rationale: pins reschedule fanout and SMS ordering

moduleContractTests.scenario: Round robin rescheduling sends attendee email only to pure attendees and organizer email to team members.
given: calEvent where person P is attendee but not team member, and person M is team member
moduleContractTests.then: P receives AttendeeRescheduledEmail and M receives OrganizerRescheduledEmail
